sar_narrative: Entity SYN_fc0f474e, a virtual asset service provider, exhibited activity consistent with layering and rapid movement of funds. Between 2026-04-25 and 2026-04-28, the entity conducted 6 wire transfers totaling $86,514,740.33 to various counterparties, including WHU Capital LLC ($15,946,550.07), VHHP Enterprises LLC ($15,257,619.32), LMI Ventures LLC ($14,644,153.27), YWZGJ Associates LLC ($14,071,107.07), IM Ventures LLC ($13,585,807.10), and MAN Solutions LLC ($13,010,103.40). These transactions are noted as 'peel-chain hops,' indicating a pattern of descending amounts. Upon verification, the auxiliary numeric finding of $82,484,840.16 is inconsistent with the underlying transactions; the re-derived total is $86,514,740.33. This activity resulted in a vs_declared_volume_ratio of 7.44 relative to the expected monthly volume of $11,632,908. This high-velocity pass-through activity warrants further review. We refer this matter to the human investigator.
